content: We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have IR spectrum data. Look for carbonyl stretch around 1700 cm-1 (typically 1650-1750). The provided wavenumbers: list includes 1608, 1605, 1587, 1584, 1505, 1501. No peaks near 1700. So likely zero carbonyl groups. However IR may miss if not present. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-220 ppm). Could also use 13C NMR. Let's get carbon NMR to confirm.
